scope: The actual SU(2) Wilson temporal-gauge ground-row response equals the original full normalized transfer on continuous gauge-invariant observables. Its localized tilt covariance vanishes exactly for a pure gauge input change. A literal row action retains the spatial weight and constructed ground amplitude; those terms cancel from input action differences, yielding the bound beta*(hi-lo)*inputCost. Compactness constructs an attained gauge-orbit cost, with nonnegativity, symmetry, triangle inequality, gauge invariance and zero exactly on gauge-equivalent pairs. The actual response and normalized collective tilt covariance are bounded by beta*(hi-lo)*orbitCost; a chosen local alignment charges only its remaining changed links. No regular or local gauge fixing, spatial covariance decay, weak-coupling contraction, physical-scale gap or nontrivial continuum limit is proved. All twelve Clay obligations remain open.

identities.row_law: nu_u(dv) is proportional to kineticWeight(u,v)*spatialWeight(v)*ground(v)*Haar(dv). ground is the existing constructed positive ground amplitude.
identities.physical_dictionary: For continuous gauge-invariant f, rowMean_f(u) equals its expectation under the original full normalized physical transfer.
identities.gauge_cancellation: Cov_{nu_u}(tilt(gauge(h)u,u),f)=0 when the tilt support contains all changed input links.
identities.row_action: A_u(v)=beta*kineticAction(u,v)-log(spatialWeight(v))-log(ground(v)). Its Gibbs law is exactly nu_u.
identities.orbit_cost: d(u,u_prime)=min_h sum_e norm(u_e-gauge(h)u_prime_e). Compactness attains this minimum.
identities.covariance_bound: |Cov_{nu_u_prime}(tilt,f)|/E_{nu_u_prime}(tilt) <= beta*(hi-lo)*d(u,u_prime); the actual denominator is strictly positive.
identities.localized_alignment: For any chosen alignment with agreement off S, replace orbit cost by the sum of residual link distances in S.

assumptions: Finite periodic spatial SU(2) lattice n>0.
Continuous real physical observables invariant under every lattice gauge transformation, with a specified finite value interval.
Localized covariance identities require agreement of the two input configurations off their stated finite support.
not_inferred: Improve the actual gauge-invariant collective response bound to a physical-scale contraction estimate uniform in cutoff and volume; its current coefficient grows with beta.
Control correlated large-field clusters, boundaries, generated interactions and renormalized source responses on an independently justified beta(a)->infinity trajectory.
If using an explicit gauge fixing or coarse block representation, prove its regularity/locality and the exact law and source dictionary; compact choice of an orbit optimizer supplies none of these.
Obtain contraction of original physical transfer powers over a fixed physical slab, and construct a surviving nonzero finite-energy continuum excitation with compatible all-order bounds.
All twelve full Clay obligations remain open.

next_physical_target.estimate: For some ell>0 and q<1 independent of cutoff and spatial volume, ||P_a^(ceil(ell/a)) v|| <= q*||v|| for every v orthogonal to the vacuum, on the same independently justified physical coupling trajectory.
next_physical_target.why_current_bound_is_insufficient: The present estimate uses the global observable interval width and has coefficient beta. It supplies neither contraction in a physical norm nor a bound on accumulated collective response over the number of time steps in a fixed physical slab.
next_physical_target.separate_continuum_requirement: Construct a nonzero finite-energy continuum source and compatible all-order renormalized bounds on that same trajectory.
